run_mrp_msetup: run the mrp msetup.py entrypoint to start alice, bob, and log processes
create_conda_process: create a named process using mrp.Conda runtime with a yaml env and run command
create_docker_process: create a named process using mrp.Docker runtime with an image and volume mounts
configure_log_process: configure a log process with pubsub topic rules and save_all policies via cfg
define_mrp_processes: define multiple mrp processes in an msetup.py file and call mrp.main to orchestrate them
